In the framework of its activities at the Guiana Space Center (CSG), CNES must renew 3 Trucks mounted crane: trucks with a crane which allows the transport, loading and unloading goods.

The trucks, which is the subject of this pre-publication, must have the following equipment to perform its main functions:
• Using a mounted crane and a flatbed to load, transport and unload
• Be driven with a “large goods vehicle” license
• Be compatible with the climatic conditions of French Guiana.
• Transport 2 people in a seated position
• Be equipped with a diesel engine with a minimum power of 280hp
• Be compatible with the European agreement concerning the international Carriage of dangerous Goods by road.
